integrity: Analytic proof and finite exact-rational check are included. No independent review or external certification is claimed.
limitations: Only S^2, two positive Fourier orders, normalized Haar measures, and negative half-order stability. Individual associated-Legendre spectral factors use well-established machinery, so full historical priority is uncertain. No Hausdorff or stronger-Sobolev bound is proved.
title: Sharp half-order stability from two great-circle Fourier modes
